claims: Fred Hoiberg is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln.
Fred Hoiberg has held the position of head men's basketball coach at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln since 2019.
Fred Hoiberg led the University of Nebraska–Lincoln men's basketball team to a school-record 15 Big Ten wins in the 2025–26 season.
Fred Hoiberg led the University of Nebraska–Lincoln men's basketball team to their first-ever NCAA Tournament victory in the 2025–26 season.
Fred Hoiberg was named Big Ten Coach of the Year following the 2025–26 season.
Fred Hoiberg received a contract extension through 2031–32.
Fred Hoiberg was born in Lincoln, Nebraska.
Fred Hoiberg played college basketball at Iowa State.
Fred Hoiberg had a 10-year NBA career.
Fred Hoiberg served as head coach at Iowa State from 2010–2015.
Fred Hoiberg served as head coach for the Chicago Bulls from 2015–2018.
Fred Hoiberg led Nebraska to a 26–5 record in the 2025-26 season.
Fred Hoiberg earned Jim Phelan National Coach of the Year honors for the 2025-26 season.
Fred Hoiberg recently signed a three-year extension to remain with the Huskers through 2031-32.
Amy Williams is the head coach of the Nebraska women's basketball team.
